cast.name: 比阿特丽斯·巴塔尔达 Beatriz Batarda

writer.name: 克劳迪亚·瓦莱乔 Cláudia Varejão

director.name: 克劳迪亚·瓦莱乔 Cláudia Varejão

introduction: Morning Light closes a circle of three short films by Cláudia Varejão on family (dis)encounters, where the roads do not always coincide and unexpected disruptions are not necessarily the result of a failure. Everyday life hides larger and quieter forces and their understanding is often presented as a task too violent or even useless. Whatever the look that is allowed to live, the transcendence of human relations will always be there, front, unwavering and gross. Morning Light approaches the distance between three generations – mother, daughter and granddaughter. In a dense river that unites them, for no apparent reason other than exhaustion, a fissure emerges.
